title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Adds RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples; updates docs site navigation and a few code examples for clarity.
description:
Motivation: Add canonical quickstarts and example playbooks for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents and tool-calling so engineers can onboard faster and reproduce examples from the docs site. This PR bundles new examples in redwood-examples, markdown quickstarts in redwood-docs, and small site config updates to expose the new pages in the sidebar.

What changed (high level):
- New quickstart templates: basic agent, agent-with-tools, and an embeddings-backed RAG example.
- Tool-calling examples for TS/Python showing structured tool outputs and function signatures.
- Docs site: new guide pages under /guides/rag-agent-quickstart, updated mkdocs nav and sidebars.
- Small test harnesses and CI checks for example smoke tests.

Checklist:
- [x] Add examples and quickstart markdown
- [x] Wire docs navigation and URLs
- [x] Add CI smoke tests for examples
- [x] Update README references in redwood-examples

Notes for reviewers: The quickstarts are intentionally minimal and opinionated (focus on serving + tool-calling patterns). Larger integration demos will follow in a separate PR to avoid a massive diff. Some code snippets are simplified to remain platform-agnostic; where we rely on Redwood SDK helpers the README links to the SDK repo for usage.

How to validate locally: follow redwood-docs/README.md to build site (mkdocs build) and run the smoke tests under scripts/example-smoke-tests/ (./run_smoke_tests.sh). The CI pipeline runs the same steps.

Related: ENG-9182 (RAG onboarding), DOC-342 (docs nav update), SUP-2041 (customer requested agent example).

Sofia Martinez: Docs build looks good locally. One nit: expand the troubleshooting section for common KMS errors.

Daniel Wu: Approved — smoke tests passed in CI and examples are small/clear enough for a quickstart.

Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates

Includes basic_agent, agent_with_tools, embeddings-backed example, docs pages, and CI smoke tests.
post_merge_notes: Docs site updated and deployed to staging; examples published to redwood-examples with a small README and a helper script (setup_examples.sh). Follow-up tasks: add extended integration demos (ENG-9201) and a guided tutorial video for the quickstarts.
changelog_entry: Added RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples (docs and examples).
testing_instructions: Build the docs site with 'mkdocs build' and run ./scripts/example-smoke-tests/run_smoke_tests.sh. Smoke tests will use Docker to spin up a minimal embedding service stub and exercise the examples. CI runs the same steps on every push to this branch.
